t: You're looking at a Henry Moore sculpture, a working model for his Reclining Figure. A working model is the smaller version an artist makes while developing a larger work. The catalogue places this one at Charing Cross Hospital. Moore is best known for semi-abstract monumental bronzes found in public places around the world. He also drew Londoners sheltering from the Blitz during the Second World War, so there is a London story running through his work.
